from marimo._ast.app import InternalApp
from marimo._ast.load import load_notebook_ir
from marimo._runtime.dataflow import topological_sort
from marimo._schemas.serialization import NotebookSerialization
from marimo._version import __version__


def _header_for_script(ir: NotebookSerialization) -> str:
    """Extract a Python script-appropriate header from the notebook IR.

    For Python-origin notebooks, ``ir.header.value`` already holds the raw
    header text (which may contain a PEP 723 ``# /// script`` block along with
    copyright comments), so it is returned verbatim.

    For Markdown-origin notebooks, ``ir.header.value`` holds YAML frontmatter
    rather than raw comment text. In that case the frontmatter is parsed and the
    PEP 723 header is reconstructed from its ``pyproject``/``header`` keys.

    Returns an empty string if the notebook has no header.
    """
    if not ir.header or not ir.header.value:
        return ""

    header = ir.header.value

    # Python-origin headers are raw comment text (every line is a comment),
    # e.g. copyright notices and/or a PEP 723 `# /// script` block.
    if header.lstrip().startswith("#"):
        return header

    # Markdown-origin headers store YAML frontmatter; reconstruct the PEP 723
    # header from the parsed frontmatter.
    from marimo._utils import yaml
    from marimo._utils.inline_script_metadata import (
        get_headers_from_frontmatter,
    )

    frontmatter = yaml.load(header) or {}
    headers = get_headers_from_frontmatter(frontmatter)
    parts = [part for part in (headers["header"], headers["pyproject"]) if part]
    return "\n".join(parts)


def convert_from_ir_to_script(ir: NotebookSerialization) -> str:
    app = InternalApp(load_notebook_ir(ir))

    # Check if any code is async, if so, raise an error

            )

    header = _header_for_script(ir)

        "# %%\n" + graph.cells[cid].code
        for cid in topological_sort(graph, graph.cells.keys())
    ]
    return f'{header}\n__generated_with = "{__version__}"\n\n' + "\n\n".join(
